Game Overview

In Angry Jump, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an endless ninja adventure in Angry Jump, where precise timing is your ultimate ally. Leap across platforms, avoid perilous falls, and tackle increasingly tricky obstacles. Hone your agility and aim for the global leaderboard in this addictive test of skill and reflexes. Can you perfect your jumps?
